rawFindings.title: Missing toString conversion for slug in create()
rawFindings.explanation: The slug is processed by slugize with data.slug || data.title directly used without converting to string. If slug or title is a non-string value (e.g., a number), slugize may receive a non-string input, potentially causing unexpected behavior or errors.
rawFindings.suggestion: Convert data.slug || data.title to string explicitly before passing to slugize, e.g., slugize((data.slug || data.title).toString(), ...)
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: Calling post.create() with data.title as a number causes slugize() to receive a non-string value, possibly throwing an error or producing incorrect slugs.

rawFindings.title: Missing toString conversion for slug in publish()
rawFindings.explanation: The slugify function is called with data.slug directly without converting it to string, which may cause errors if data.slug is not a string (e.g., number).
rawFindings.suggestion: Convert data.slug to string explicitly before slugizing, e.g., slugize(data.slug.toString(), ...)
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: Calling post.publish() with data.slug as a number causes slugize() to receive a non-string value, possibly throwing an error or invalid slug generation.
